description: All job-aggregator platforms, re-checked live in one pass so every row shares a schema and a vintage. 'verification' says what answered; 'bot_safe' says whether an unattended fetch can expect to get the page. These are NOT scannable by the job-sentinel adapters (which speak Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/SmartRecruiters/Workday APIs) - an aggregator has no such API. Treat this as a human/manual-search reference list.

verification_vocabulary.broken_corrected: Original host dead; a working successor was found and verified.
verification_vocabulary.blocked_bot_filter: 403/429 to a non-browser client. Live, but not bot-fetchable.
verification_vocabulary.tls_untrusted_live: Serves the page, but its TLS chain fails validation.
verification_vocabulary.broken_needs_review: Unreachable on every attempt; no verified replacement.
